steps.en: Staff logs in and the system checks identity and access
steps.id: Staff login dan sistem cek identitas serta akses
steps.why_en: Identity check only runs on a few paths and is skipped in UAT.
steps.why_id: Cek identitas hanya jalan di beberapa path dan dilewati di UAT.

steps.en: Only admin staff see the Role Function Mapping menu
steps.id: Hanya staff admin yang melihat menu Role Function Mapping
steps.why_en: The menu is hidden, but opening the page address directly is not role-checked.
steps.why_id: Menu disembunyikan, tapi membuka alamat halaman langsung tidak dicek role.

steps.en: System lists all roles with application, role id and name
steps.id: Sistem menampilkan semua role dengan aplikasi, id dan nama role

steps.en: Staff searches roles by id or name
steps.id: Staff mencari role berdasarkan id atau nama

steps.en: Roles are sorted by name; staff cannot choose the sort
steps.id: Role diurutkan menurut nama; staff tidak bisa memilih urutan
steps.why_en: Order is fixed by name and there is no sort by role id.
steps.why_id: Urutan tetap menurut nama dan tidak ada sort menurut role id.

steps.en: Staff exports the shown role list to a spreadsheet file
steps.id: Staff mengekspor daftar role yang tampil ke file spreadsheet
steps.why_en: The export is a CSV file, not a real Excel file.
steps.why_id: Hasil ekspor berupa file CSV, bukan file Excel asli.

steps.en: Edit opens a form showing the functions already given to the role
steps.id: Edit membuka form berisi function yang sudah dimiliki role

steps.en: Only functions of the role's application can be picked
steps.id: Hanya function milik aplikasi role yang bisa dipilih
steps.why_en: Only the screen limits the choice; the system does not check the application.
steps.why_id: Hanya layar yang membatasi pilihan; sistem tidak mengecek aplikasi.

steps.en: Staff adds or removes functions in the selection
steps.id: Staff menambah atau menghapus function di pilihan

steps.en: At least one function must stay on the role
steps.id: Minimal satu function harus tetap ada di role
steps.why_en: Only the screen enforces this; the system accepts an empty list.
steps.why_id: Hanya layar yang menjaga ini; sistem menerima list kosong.

steps.en: Submit saves the chosen list as the full function list of the role
steps.id: Submit menyimpan daftar pilihan sebagai daftar function lengkap role

steps.en: Changes apply directly with no approval step
steps.id: Perubahan langsung berlaku tanpa langkah approval

steps.en: A failure shows a pop-up with an error message
steps.why_en: The pop-up is generic and only covers some error codes.
steps.why_id: Pop-up bersifat umum dan hanya untuk sebagian kode error.

steps.en: Only admin staff can change the mapping behind the screen
steps.id: Hanya staff admin yang bisa mengubah mapping di balik layar
steps.why_en: The system has no role check; only the menu is restricted.
steps.why_id: sistem tidak mengecek role; hanya menu yang dibatasi.
